title: The Hollow Oath
author: Silas Coldharbour
blurb: Freya Hartwell, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
